title: Soundcheck evidence pack
description: eaa/evidence.json in the folder of an --eaa run or snapshot: the SHA-256 of every file the run recorded, chained to the previous --eaa run of the same target. rhythm soundcheck evidence verify checks it; evidence sign adds eaa/evidence.sig (ed25519 over these bytes, base64) and eaa/evidence.pub (the public key, base64). Fields are only added within rhythm-soundcheck/evidence/v1.

sha256.description: Of the vendored axe.min.js the run used.

chrome.description: The browser's version; empty when the caller didn't record it.

options.description: The run's options as run.json records them (run.v1.json): the flags the run was made with.

interrupted.description: The run was stopped before it finished; its results are partial.

insecure.description: TLS certificates weren't verified (-k). Such a pack can't be signed.

pages.description: Whether each module's audit of each page finished.

files.description: Every recorded file, sorted by path: run.json (hashed as encoding/json writes it again: keys sorted, no spacing), the pages file, keyboard/ traces and eaa/focus/ crops.

eaa.description: The run's accessibility summary, as the eaa block of run --json (run.v1.json).

previous.description: The pack of the previous --eaa run of the same target, null for the first.

amends.description: Present when the pack was recorded again after its run's files were changed on purpose (an accept into a snapshot). The pack it replaces and the files that one lists are kept in .soundcheck/evidence/<sha256>/, so packs chained to it can still be checked.

sha256.description: Of the eaa/evidence.json this pack replaces.

reason.description: What changed the files, such as accept.

runId.description: The run's folder in .soundcheck/, such as runs/2026-10-26T09-00-00 or snapshots/eaa-1.
